definition: Morning-after headache, nausea and regret. Fancy name: veisalgia. Water and time help; no hangover cure beats the second-last drink.
Lymphoid tissue at the back of the nose, above the tonsils. Big ones cause snoring and mouth breathing in kids, and they shrink by the teens.
As in psammoma bodies: tiny layered calcium specks seen down the microscope in papillary thyroid cancer, meningioma and serous ovarian tumours. Greek psammos, sand.
Relating to the cochlea, the snail-shaped hearing organ. The multichannel cochlear implant was pioneered in Melbourne by Graeme Clark’s team, first implanted in 1978.

Chlamydial eye infection that scars the eyelids and can blind. Australia is the only high-income country where it’s still endemic, in some remote Aboriginal communities. Clean faces and safe water help end it.
